summary: Plain field getter (__thiscall): returns the dword at offset 0x20 of this as an int. No side effects, no writes, no callees. Consistent with the template prelabel 'getter: returns field 0x20 of this'. The returned value is consumed by UI/session and object-lookup callers.

operations.description: Return the dword stored at this[8] (byte offset 0x20).

Read by SessionMessageUICommandHandler (0x00470490), UIWidgetVisibilityToggle (0x0048B91A), UIActiveStateToggle (0x0048BBE0), StructInitWithConditionalDefaultRead (0x00567900) and ObjectIDLookupAcross9Arrays (0x005684A0), so the field is read in UI/session and object-id paths.
